name: harness-injected-config
summary: Two package-level globals holding harness state are replaced by fields on the lint pane, and PrepareWorktree gains a prepared map parameter. Every call site is updated in the same commit. Glob patterns gain a compile cache.
why_this_fixture_exists: An exported signature changes and the callers live in other packages. The review should confirm the callers moved rather than invent a break, which is the failure mode a caller-blind reviewer has here.

expect.what: The prepared map is read before it is written and the write is guarded by a nil check, so passing nil is accepted and silently disables the deduplication the parameter exists for.
expect.note: Worth having, not required. Marked optional so a run that misses it is not scored as a miss.

quiet.note: Every caller of PrepareWorktree is updated in this same commit. A finding that says one was not is a false positive, and the expensive kind: it sends the author looking for a break that is not there.
